subtitle: Postdoctoral Fellow at MBARI working on multi-camera perception, 3D reconstruction, SLAM, and robotics in underwater and polar environments.
summary: My research focuses on multi-camera perception, 3D reconstruction, and simultaneous localization and mapping in dynamic and visually degraded environments spanning urban, marine, and polar regions.

experience.text: Multi-modal representation learning for underwater navigation. 3D Gaussian splatting for large-scale dense mapping. Self-supervised learning for scene understanding.

experience.organization: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
experience.text: Multi-camera perception for underwater vehicle situational awareness. Real-time dense reconstruction of subsea infrastructure and shipwrecks.

experience.organization: Institute of Experiential Robotics, Northeastern University
experience.text: Toyota Research Institute collaboration on multi-modal SLAM. Optimal sensor arrangement research. Arctic glacier mapping expeditions.
Ph.D. research on multi-camera systems for robust real-time robot perception. Hardware and software design for synchronized multi-camera arrays. AVATAR Xprize competition.
Driver interruptibility prediction for ADAS speech interfaces. CAN bus data analysis for intelligent vehicle-driver communication timing.
